segments.text: Your job files are evidence. Photos, readings, scope notes, client conversations. The record you would take into a dispute.
Bring Your Own Key means that record stays under your account, on your keys, in your storage.
You connect your own AI provider key. The prompts run on your account, under your contract, at the rate your provider charges you.
RestoreAssist orchestrates the work. It does not sit between you and your data, and it does not resell you your own compute.
If you ever leave, you leave with everything. No export request, no waiting period.
For anyone holding client data under an obligation, that distinction is the entire point.
Add your key in Settings. Nothing else about your workflow changes.
